basic_details.job_title: Nashik District Revenue Servant (Kotwal) Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 8 Posts

how_to_apply: Visit the official portal at nashik.kotwal.org.
Read the detailed advertisement and instructions carefully.
Complete the online application form with accurate personal and educational details.
Upload a scanned copy of the latest passport-size photograph and signature.
Pay the application fee online using Net Banking, Debit Card, Credit Card, Google Pay, or PhonePe.
Submit the online application and keep a printout of the submitted form and fee receipt.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The 8 temporary vacancies for Revenue Servant (Kotwal) in Deola Taluka are distributed across specific villages and reservation categories as follows:

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Educational Qualification: Candidates must have passed at least the 4th standard. Age Limit: Applicants must be between 18 and 40 years of age as of 03 October 2026. Residence Requirement: The applicant must be a resident of a village included within the respective Saja of Deola taluka. Physical Fitness: Candidates must be physically fit to perform the duties of the Revenue Servant (Kotwal) post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: Selected candidates will receive a consolidated remuneration of Rs. 15,000/- per month. The post is filled on a temporary (तात्पुरत्या स्वरूपात) basis.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Selection for the Revenue Servant (Kotwal) post involves a Written Examination carrying 100 marks, consisting of 50 objective multiple-choice questions based on general knowledge. Candidates must secure a minimum of 40 marks in the written examination to qualify. Provisional selection lists are prepared based on written exam scores, followed by original document verification.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for Nashik District Revenue Servant (Kotwal) Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit online applications is 17 October 2026 up to 05:45 PM.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Kotwal post?
faq.answer: Candidates must have passed at least the 4th standard.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: Applicants must be between 18 and 40 years of age as of 03 October 2026.

faq.question: Q4. Is the Revenue Servant (Kotwal) post permanent or temporary?
faq.answer: The post of Revenue Servant (Kotwal) is filled on a temporary (तात्पुरत्या स्वरूपात) basis for 8 vacancies.

faq.question: Q5. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process comprises a Written Examination of 100 marks consisting of 50 objective multiple-choice questions, followed by document verification, medical examination, and police character verification.
